measurements.script: if (params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo'] != null && doc.containsKey('addI.nudgeInfo.realTimeScoringEnabled') && params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo']['realTimeScoringEnabled'] == true && params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo']['taskDetails'] != null && params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo']['taskDetails'].size() > 0) {     int numberOfTasks = params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo']['taskDetails'].size();     int completedCount = 0;     for (task in params['_source']['addI']['nudgeInfo']['taskDetails']) {         if (task != null && task.containsKey('completed') && task['completed'] == true) {             completedCount++;         }     }     return (completedCount * 100.0) / numberOfTasks; } return 0.0;
